description: AutoKan AI Context panel config. Only `ai_context` is consumed (by server/src/routes/docs.js — the Settings → AI Context panel). Capabilities and runners live in server/src/seed/runners.json; default agents in server/src/seed/agent-templates.json. Earlier versions of this file held `models`, `agents`, `columns`, and `pipeline` sections — all superseded by the registry and removed.
